Proposition
[ODE criterion for moving convex sets] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0067, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0068, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0069 ↗ def:chow-ii-forward-track-direction ↗ lem:chow-ii-distance-support ↗ cor:chow-ii-dini-monotonicity 1. ch10:10.61\group Convex geometry

The ODE preserves every $\mathcal J(t)$ iff $F(V,t)\in D_{(V,t)}\mathcal L$ at every boundary point of the closed track.
Proof

\sketch Necessity follows by taking difference quotients of an ODE trajectory. For sufficiency, if an ODE trajectory exits, use the first exit interval and its distance to $\mathcal J(t)$. Closedness gives left lower semicontinuity and right continuity. Supporting points and forward directions yield $d^+s/dt\le Cs$, contradicting $s(t_1)=0$ by the Dini barrier.

□
